shorts_extract.hook: Three balls, ninety days, and three MRI scans: how Bogdan Draganski & Arne May (2004 Nature) filmed 'Use It or Lose It' gray-matter growth live.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Draganski et al. (2004 Nature): 24 non-jugglers across T1 Baseline to T2 90-Day Juggling to T3 90-Day Washout + May (2004) & Boyke (2008 seniors).
shorts_extract.twist: Why visual-motion hMT+/V5 grew instead of hand cortex, dendritic/glial biology, 60-year-old plasticity, and preventing Scan-3 shrinkage.
